title: GAP Waiver Addenda Terms: Coverage Period and Attachment to the Contract
content:
The following terms apply alike to all six GAP Waiver Addenda plans: GAP Waiver 120, 130, 140 and 150, GAP Waiver Plus 150 and GAP Waiver Premier 150.

| Term | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Coverage begins | on the contract date |
| Coverage ends | on the contract's original maturity date at signing; extensions and due-date changes never lengthen coverage |
| Length of the addendum term | equal to the contract's original term |
| Transfer | not transferable to another vehicle or another contract |
| Open addenda on one contract | at most 1 addendum that is not closed |

**The coverage end date is fixed at signing.** The last day of coverage is the original maturity date written into the contract at signing. Extensions and due-date changes later in the contract's life can move its maturity, but they never move the end of GAP coverage.

**One addendum per contract.** A contract never carries more than 1 addendum that is not closed at the same time. The addendum belongs to the contract and vehicle it was sold with, and it does not move with the borrower to another vehicle or another contract.

### Points of judgement

- *Does an extension granted late in the contract extend the GAP coverage?* No. Coverage still ends on the original maturity date at signing.
- *Can a borrower who trades in the vehicle carry the addendum onto the replacement contract?* No. The addendum is not transferable.
